FN-AR89B77-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 69
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Matthew Hammett
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 01/13/2026
House Bill 69 as introduced could increase annual receipts to the Alabama Department of
Environmental Management (ADEM) Fund by an estimated maximum of: (1) $33,000 by
increasing the $200 per year water well drillers license fee to a $1,000 biennial unrestricted
water well drillers license fee; (2) $50,000 from a $500 biennial restricted water well drillers
license fee; (3) $146,750 from water well completion certificate fees collected for private wells;
(4) $700,000 from water well completion certificate fees collected for environmental monitoring
wells; and (5) $10,000 from water well completion certificate fees collected for public wells,
totaling $939,750 per year.
